name: Carrossel with Glider.js
author: Jonathan Afranio

sections.description:
🇧🇷: O Glider.js, o Carousel em javascript puro (vanilla.js) para WordPress.

🇺🇸: Glider.js, Carousel in pure javascript (vanilla.js) for WordPress.

🇪🇸: El Glider.js, el carrusel en javascript puro (vanilla.js) para WordPress.

Features / Funcionalidades / Características

🇧🇷:
* 5 layouts (designs) prontos: only-images, text-full-image, text-half-image, only_text, small-thumb.
* Custom Post Type (“Carousel”) + categorias: cada item do carrossel é gerenciado como um post, com sua própria imagem destacada, link e janela de destino.
* Responsivo: quantidade de itens e de rolagem configurável separadamente para mobile, tablet, laptop e desktop.
* Tela de configurações (Carousel Config) com abas, seletor de cor nativo do WordPress e:
* Imagem/SVG customizado para as setas de navegação (anterior/próxima).
* Campo de CSS customizado, aplicado automaticamente em toda página com carrossel.
* Pronto para tradução (pt_BR, pt_PT, es_ES, es_AR incluídos).

🇺🇸:
* 5 built-in layouts (designs): only-images, text-full-image, text-half-image, only_text, small-thumb.
* Custom Post Type (“Carousel”) + categories, so each carousel item is managed like a post, with its own featured image, link and target window.
* Responsive: independent item count and scroll count for mobile, tablet, laptop and desktop.
* Settings page (Carousel Config) with tabs, native WordPress color picker, and:
* Custom image/SVG for the previous/next navigation arrows.
* Custom CSS field, applied automatically on every page that renders a carousel.
* Translation-ready (pt_BR, pt_PT, es_ES, es_AR included).

🇪🇸:
* 5 diseños incorporados: only-images, text-full-image, text-half-image, only_text, small-thumb.
* Custom Post Type (“Carousel”) + categorías: cada elemento del carrusel se gestiona como un post, con su propia imagen destacada, enlace y ventana de destino.
* Responsivo: cantidad de elementos y de desplazamiento configurable por separado para móvil, tablet, laptop y escritorio.
* Página de configuración (Carousel Config) con pestañas, selector de color nativo de WordPress, y:
* Imagen/SVG personalizado para las flechas de navegación (anterior/siguiente).
* Campo de CSS personalizado, aplicado automáticamente en toda página que muestre un carrusel.
* Listo para traducción (pt_BR, pt_PT, es_ES, es_AR incluidos).
sections.installation:
🇧🇷 Instalação

  1. Envie a pasta carrossel-glider-js inteira para o diretório /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Ative o plugin na tela Plugins > Plugins Instalados.

Você vai encontrar o menu Carousel no admin do WordPress.

🇺🇸 Installation

  1. Upload the entire carrossel-glider-js folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen (Plugins > Installed Plugins).

You will find the Carousel menu in your WordPress admin screen.

🇪🇸 Instalación

  1. Sube la carpeta carrossel-glider-js completa al directorio /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activa el plugin en la pantalla Plugins > Plugins Instalados.

Encontrarás el menú Carousel en el panel de administración de WordPress.

sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Rewritten from procedural code to an object-oriented structure with PHP namespaces (CGJ\) and a lightweight PSR-4-style autoloader (no more scattered require_once).
  • Settings page redesigned: native WordPress tabs (Setas, Marcadores, Texto com imagem, Texto sem imagem, Links, Avançado) and the native WordPress color picker instead of plain <input type="color"> fields.
  • New: custom image/SVG for the “previous” and “next” navigation arrows (Media Library picker), replacing the built-in SVG icons when set.
  • New: custom CSS field (Avançado tab), printed in its own <style> block on every page that renders a carousel.
  • Fix: saving a “carousel” post no longer overwrites the link/target meta fields of unrelated posts (the save_post handler is now scoped to the carousel post type only).
  • Various small hardening fixes (esc_url/esc_attr added where missing, wp_reset_postdata() after the carousel query).
  • No breaking changes — updating from 1.0.3 works like any normal plugin update, no manual steps needed.

1.0.3

  • Previous stable release (procedural code base).
